title: Two signed-in players meet, talk, lose their connection and come back; and the presence server holds against malformed, stale and abusive clients

milestones.title: Both players connect to the same city and are welcomed
Both sign in with one-use tickets and are verified
Each sees the other come into view, once
A nearby line is heard once, and its retry is answered, not said again
Walking out of view is seen as leaving, and back as coming in
A dropped connection is seen to leave
Reconnecting signs in again and is seen once, not twice
A line retried after a reconnect is answered, not said twice
A game speaking another protocol is told so and closed
A ticket already used cannot sign in again
Malformed and out-of-range messages change nothing they should not
A flood of messages is cut, and the server stays up for everyone
A client that stops reading is skipped, not waited for, and recovers
Presence messages cannot create visits, presses or purchases
Every message the server sent fits the protocol's contracts
